title: Asset and Deadline
author: Astrid Villalobos
blurb: Bram Ravensworth, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
